scientific_limitations: Exact one-generation hypergeometric partition-and-cull, with 2m parent cells of which m are infected, strict death above half-infected, and only daughter sizes 1,2,3; not a population-level or multigeneration prediction.
title: A universal two-cell bottleneck penalty in majority-lethal multicellular fragmentation
